item.title: Solve: the cost of insuring against debt defaults at hyperscalers Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, and Oracle has hit its highest level since 2021 (Gunjan Banerji/Wall Street Journal)
item.description:
Gunjan Banerji / Wall Street Journal:
Solve: the cost of insuring against debt defaults at hyperscalers Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, and Oracle has hit its highest level since 2021  —  With trillions riding on the artificial-intelligence trade, investors, traders and tech executives alike are hunting for high-stakes protection

Original (direct link): https://www.wsj.com/finance/stocks/ai-investors-are-racing-to-get-insurance-on-the-biggest-market-bet-in-history-a60e296f?st=AXJFTG

item.title: A look at a crude campaign of cyberattacks by Russia-linked hacktivist groups that have caused physical damage in NATO-aligned countries over the past two years (Ryan Gallagher/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Ryan Gallagher / Bloomberg:
A look at a crude campaign of cyberattacks by Russia-linked hacktivist groups that have caused physical damage in NATO-aligned countries over the past two years  —  Cyberattacks causing physical damage are on the rise in NATO countries, and the hackers carrying them out don't always understand what they're doing.

item.title: Lumaril, which develops AI software for optimizing industrial production by connecting to existing control systems, raised a $66M Series A at a $400M valuation (Sarah Klearman/Wall Street Journal)
item.description:
Sarah Klearman / Wall Street Journal:
Lumaril, which develops AI software for optimizing industrial production by connecting to existing control systems, raised a $66M Series A at a $400M valuation  —  The AI-for-manufacturers company has raised $66 million at a $400 million valuation  —  Think of running a production line on a factory floor as a kind of art.

Original (direct link): https://www.wsj.com/pro/venture-capital/ai-startup-lumaril-wants-to-make-factories-the-best-version-of-themselves-b65ea83d

item.title: Binance has started resuming withdrawals in phases, including for BTC and ETH, after covering 95% of the $6.3B in tokens stolen in the hack by TraderTraitor (Reuters)
item.description:
Reuters:
Binance has started resuming withdrawals in phases, including for BTC and ETH, after covering 95% of the $6.3B in tokens stolen in the hack by TraderTraitor  —  Binance, the world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange, said it would resume withdrawals in phases after covering 95% of the $6.3 billion …

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/binance-resume-withdrawals-after-recovering-bulk-6-billion-stolen-funds-2026-11-01/

item.title: Shanghai-based NeuroXess, which is developing BCI technology for movement support, speech decoding, and control of external devices, raised a ~$105M Series B (TechNode)
item.description:
TechNode:
Shanghai-based NeuroXess, which is developing BCI technology for movement support, speech decoding, and control of external devices, raised a ~$105M Series B  —  Chinese brain-computer interface startup NeuroXess has raised RMB 700 million in Series B funding, co-led by SDIC Juli, Shenzhen Capital Group and Qinzhi Capital.

Original (direct link): https://technode.com/2026/10/28/brain-computer-interface-startup-neuroxess-raises-rmb-700-million-in-series-b-funding/

item.title: Enterprise voice AI tools provider Deepgram acquires Daily, which has raised $62M+ and develops open-source voice AI framework Pipecat, for an undisclosed sum (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
item.description:
Ivan Mehta / TechCrunch:
Enterprise voice AI tools provider Deepgram acquires Daily, which has raised $62M+ and develops open-source voice AI framework Pipecat, for an undisclosed sum  —  The voice AI sector is hot, and top players are trying to consolidate their position as more business models come to the fore through partnerships and acquisitions.

Original (direct link): https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/29/deepgram-acquires-pipecat-maker-daily-to-bolster-its-voice-ai-infrastructure/

item.title: DeepSeek open sources Super-Agent, a coding agent research prototype it says proactively monitors developer group chats for coding issues and suggests solutions (Debby Wu/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Debby Wu / Bloomberg:
DeepSeek open sources Super-Agent, a coding agent research prototype it says proactively monitors developer group chats for coding issues and suggests solutions  —  DeepSeek has released a prototype of a more autonomous coding agent as it seeks to challenge Anthropic PBC's popular Claude Code.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-01/deepseek-drops-enhanced-coding-agent-with-aim-to-rival-anthropic

item.title: Insurance software maker Guidewire agrees to acquire Hyperexponential, which makes AI-powered insurance underwriting and pricing software, for $1.7B+ in cash (Anzar Mehraj/Reuters)
item.description:
Anzar Mehraj / Reuters:
Insurance software maker Guidewire agrees to acquire Hyperexponential, which makes AI-powered insurance underwriting and pricing software, for $1.7B+ in cash  —  Insurance software maker Guidewire (GWRE.N) said on Tuesday it would buy hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash and up to $400 million …

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/guidewire-buy-uk-insurance-ai-firm-hyperexponential-deal-worth-up-21-billion-2026-10-27/

item.title: The FBI attributes the $6.3B Binance hack to North Korea's elite hacking unit TraderTraitor, which the agency has also blamed for the $1.5B Bybit hack in 2025 (Kevin Whitelaw/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Kevin Whitelaw / Bloomberg:
The FBI attributes the $6.3B Binance hack to North Korea's elite hacking unit TraderTraitor, which the agency has also blamed for the $1.5B Bybit hack in 2025  —  The FBI said that North Korea was responsible for stealing more than $6 billion in cryptocurrencies in a brazen hacking attack on Binance.

Original (direct link): https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-31/fbi-blames-north-korea-for-6-billion-binance-crypto-hack

item.title: Tests: chatbots rely on three obscure AI-built voter sites for US midterm answers; Copilot cited the error-prone Ballot Brief in 75% of tests and ChatGPT in 22% (Washington Post)
item.description:
Washington Post:
Tests: chatbots rely on three obscure AI-built voter sites for US midterm answers; Copilot cited the error-prone Ballot Brief in 75% of tests and ChatGPT in 22%  —  Frustrated with hunting for information on political candidates, Ben Torres Ezrick set out to build a one-stop shop for voters.

Original (direct link): https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2026/10/30/how-an-obscure-website-became-force-americas-election-information-machine/?pwapi_token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..lCIALy15UkNNilYI0FU_HKDmoqz6MM-BgZD4xUT8pME&itid=gfta

item.title: Researchers are paid $5K for reporting a bug to OpenAI that would let attackers run code in logged-in sessions of all who opened the hacker's ChatGPT share link (Swati Khandelwal/The Hacker News)
item.description:
Swati Khandelwal / The Hacker News:
Researchers are paid $5K for reporting a bug to OpenAI that would let attackers run code in logged-in sessions of all who opened the hacker's ChatGPT share link  —  A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it …

Original (direct link): https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/a-shared-chatgpt-link-could-run.html

item.title: Sources: Meta built a prototype humanoid robot with Chinese firm Fourier in three months and is building a second; Meta says it has no plans to sell these units (Jyoti Mann/The Information)
item.description:
Jyoti Mann / The Information:
Sources: Meta built a prototype humanoid robot with Chinese firm Fourier in three months and is building a second; Meta says it has no plans to sell these units  —  Meta Platforms has built a prototype humanoid with Chinese robotics company Fourier and is already working on a second version …

Original (direct link): https://www.theinformation.com/articles/meta-built-humanoid-prototype-chinese-startup-ramp-robotics-push

item.title: Binance says it has covered 90% of its hack losses, having set aside $6.34B+ of company funds; the remaining 10% is in less liquid tokens (Angela Christy/Reuters)
item.description:
Angela Christy / Reuters:
Binance says it has covered 90% of its hack losses, having set aside $6.34B+ of company funds; the remaining 10% is in less liquid tokens  —  Cryptocurrency exchange Binance said on Saturday that it was able to cover 90% of the amount stolen during its recent hack.

Original (direct link): https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/binance-says-90-stolen-assets-replenished-2026-10-31/

item.title: How AI detectors like Pangram are changing human writing: authors drop em dashes, "not X, but Y" phrasing, and words like "delve", or add typos, to look human (Morgan Meaker/Bloomberg)
item.description:
Morgan Meaker / Bloomberg:
How AI detectors like Pangram are changing human writing: authors drop em dashes, “not X, but Y” phrasing, and words like “delve”, or add typos, to look human  —  As AI transforms writing and detectors like Pangram police what counts as machine-generated …

item.description:
Gaby Del Valle / The Verge:
A look at growing bipartisan opposition to AI data centers in drought-stricken Arizona, where TSMC's chip fabs were welcomed but newer projects face backlash  —  Industry has drained the state's water reserves for decades.  Data centers are the breaking point.﻿  —  AA hulking gray giant rises from the desert.
